title: Combining fixed and free assignments
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P\subseteq[n]$, and choose a sign assignment on $P$ and a sign assignment on $[n]\setminus P$. Their combination is the sign assignment on $[n]$ that uses the first assignment on $P$ and the second on its complement.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a set of coordinates in $[n]$
